BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring entities offering medicare advantage coverage in Washington to provide certain disclosures to consumers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring entities offering medicare advantage coverage in Washington to provide certain disclosures to consumers; and adding a new chapter to Title 19 RCW.

BillSectionHeader.P: (1) An entity offering medicare advantage coverage to Washington residents shall disclose the following information to enrollees and potential enrollees:

BillSection.P: (a) The entity's claims denial rate expressed as a percentage;
(b) The percentage of denied claims granted upon appeal; and
(c) The process through which an enrollee may appeal a denial of coverage.
(2) The disclosures required in subsection (1) of this section must be made prior to enrollment and upon request after enrollment.

BillSectionHeader.P: The legislature finds that the practices covered by this chapter are matters vitally affecting the public interest for the purpose of applying the consumer protection act, chapter 19.86 RCW. A violation of this chapter is not reasonable in relation to the development and preservation of business and is an unfair or deceptive act in trade or commerce and an unfair method of competition for the purpose of applying the consumer protection act, chapter 19.86 RCW.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute a new chapter in Title 19 RCW.
